WCAG 2.2 · AA color checks

Checks follow the selected state, not live pointer or keyboard focus. Ratios display rounded; pass/fail uses the full value. Disabled controls are exempt, not “passing.”

THE FINE PRINT MATTERS

A useful lens.
Not a certificate.

Normal text needs 4.5:1; large text needs 3:1 (at least 24px regular or about 18.7px bold). Necessary UI boundaries and state indicators generally need 3:1 against adjacent colors. These checks treat sample text as normal-sized.

Focus color contrast is only one part of focus accessibility. Visibility, area, obscuration, keyboard operation, errors, semantics, images, transparency and real layouts still need review. This tool does not certify WCAG conformance.
